summary.description: Mercury is a silver-colored liquid metal at room temperature, odorless and non-flammable. It forms inorganic salts and hazardous organo-mercury compounds.
environmental_impact: Persistent pollutant with potential for long-range atmospheric transport
Bioaccumulates in aquatic organisms, leading to higher concentrations in insects, birds, and fish
Toxic to humans, especially the nervous system; exposure mainly through contaminated fish and grain
Harmful to wildlife, plants, and microorganisms

top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: Mercury exposure harms the human nervous system, is potentially carcinogenic, and poses significant health risks through contaminated food and inhalation.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG14_Life_Below_Water: Mercury bioaccumulates in aquatic ecosystems, affecting insects, birds, and fish, and disrupting aquatic food chains globally.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG6_Clean_Water_and_Sanitation: Mercury contaminates water sources due to its persistence and transport, threatening the safety and quality of clean water supplies.
